name: GLOAM
author: David Ryan
tagline: witch house and melodic dubstep: choir, wobble, rain
description: GLOAM is a groovebox for witch house and melodic dubstep. Five lanes: drums with nudges, falling rolls and kept looseness (UNSNAP); bass as an 808, reese or beat-locked wobble; minor chords, voice-led and ducked by the kick; a choir singing a vocal bank with pitch and formant apart; and air (rain, crackle, wind). SCREW slows and lowers everything; a reverb freezes. A 32-section arranger with follow actions, transitions and macro ramps; live launch, hold and recording. LANTERN makes the keys lit pads.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Its factory voice is sung by its own formant synthesiser. Fonts: Barlow (SIL OFL 1.1).
